notes: These portable C++ TCK scenarios use only IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador interfaces and the C++ standard library. The adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, callback model, and logical-time implementation. The order-classification case checks ordinary and timestamped Update Attribute Values at one receiver; its FDD-preferred-order scenario also calls the no-time overload for a TSO-preferred attribute while the publisher regulates and observes ordinary reflection. The recipient-conversion case checks one timestamped update reported as RECEIVE to an unconstrained recipient and TIMESTAMP to a constrained recipient. The new optional-timestamp branch is C++-only for now; these scenarios distinguish standard reflection callback metadata without provider-specific names, headers, registries, or behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador ordinary and timestamped Update Attribute Values, object publication, attribute order control, time-role, and time-advance services with FederateAmbassador ordinary and timestamped reflection callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador object-management and time-management declarations
